selection_policy.name: evenly_spaced_transcript_windows
selection_policy.rule: Split the completed transcript into sequential 12-minute windows, keep windows that are at least 10 minutes long, then select six evenly spaced positions from first eligible to last eligible. Topic Engine predictions are not read.
